brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: read.capacity
objective.description: Return the full JSON descriptor of a named engine capacity.

#root.role: Resolve a capacity name against the engine capacity set and return its full JSON descriptor.

cap_name._comment: Required. The capacity name as used in an intention (e.g. matter.read, read.state, wrapper.start). Must exactly match a known engine capacity name.

include_raw._comment: Optional, default false. When true, also return descriptor_json: the raw source JSON string preserving original key order. Only needed when the caller intends to reproduce that exact key order in a later write (e.g. via content_json on edit.create). Omit for read-only inspection to avoid paying for a duplicate payload.

detail._comment: Optional, default 'invoke'. Accepted values: 'invoke' (functional.#root reduced to {role, inputs, outputs} — drops effects, transformation_contract, and any other narrative fields), 'full' (entire descriptor, unchanged). Use the 'invoke' default when only building an invocation; pass 'full' when the capacity's behavior is not yet understood. Ignored when include_raw is true and only descriptor_json is consulted, since descriptor_json is never filtered.

cap_name._comment: Normalized capacity name as resolved by the engine.

descriptor._comment: Parsed capacity descriptor as a structured JSON object. Key order may differ from source. functional.#root is reduced to {role, inputs, outputs} unless detail is 'full'.

descriptor_json._comment: Present only when include_raw is true. Raw JSON string of the capacity descriptor, preserving original source key order. Parse this when key order matters.

effects.embedded_capacity_set: The engine embedded capacity set is queried read-only. No context state is modified.

transformation_contract.morphing: A capacity name becomes the corresponding parsed JSON descriptor exposed as a structured payload.
invariants: Resolution is read-only and never modifies local context state.
The capacity name must exactly match a known engine capacity; partial names or wildcards are not supported.
descriptor (parsed object) is always returned; descriptor_json (raw string) is only included when include_raw is true.
descriptor_json, when included, always carries the full raw source — detail never filters it, only descriptor.
success: Returns the normalized cap_name and the parsed descriptor object; descriptor_json is included only when include_raw was requested.
failure: Fails when params.cap_name is missing or does not match any known engine capacity.
